propositions: The packaged code-review guide at src/rebar/_guides/passing-code-review.md lines 112–114 contains stale text instructing contributors to ping maintainers for coverage-gap BLOCK re-triggers, when contributor self-service via `recheck-review` comment now exists.
The stale guidance actively misdirects contributors despite `recheck-review` being live in production (Gerrit change 1243) and documented in CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/review-policy.md.
The coverage-gap bullet must be updated to name `recheck-review` as the primary contributor self-service re-trigger and clarify it mirrors `recheck` for CI consistency.
The packaged guide is the single most discoverable contributor on-ramp for the Gerrit LLM-Review gate and requires synchronization with policy and runbook docs to avoid misdirection.
